items.headline: Seven detached ADUs permitted at one N 2nd St property
items.summary: Permits were issued for seven separate two-story detached accessory dwelling units (#9-#15) at 584 N 2nd St, each valued near $569,000. All seven were cleared to build the same day, pointing to a coordinated backyard-unit project on a single lot.

items.headline: Three single-family homes permitted on Beach Hill Farm St
items.summary: Permits for three new single-family homes in the Comm Hill 3.2 development were issued at 2556, 2558, and 2560 Beach Hill Farm St, each valued around $412,000-$417,000.

items.headline: Council to hear appeal of Civic Center Drive townhome project
items.summary: The City Council is scheduled to rule on an appeal of a permit approval for demolishing existing buildings at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street to build 14 townhomes and a duplex with commercial space; the project was found exempt from standard environmental review under a 2025 state law.

items.headline: Environmental review scoping meeting for Oakmead Pkwy housing project
items.summary: The city held a public scoping meeting for the environmental impact report on a proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway, the first step in reviewing the development's potential impacts.
